headline: Anthropic has reportedly discussed having Google guarantee its US data centre lease payments as it prepares for a Wall Street listing.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: the lease deals are reported; the Google guarantee is only discussed, and the summary says so.
importance_line: It shows how much Anthropic's build-out relies on backing from rivals, but the Google guarantee is unconfirmed and the date of the Reuters report is unclear.
summary: Reuters reports, as relayed by Yellow.com, that Anthropic has signed more than a dozen preliminary deals to lease US data centres with combined capacity above 1 gigawatt. Executives have also discussed Google standing behind those lease payments if Anthropic could not meet them, but neither company has confirmed the details and Google declined to comment on the reports.
notes: Reuters not found in Google News and not readable here. Read the Yellow.com text (dated 7 Oct) that says 'Reuters reported Thursday'. Date conflict: freshness is NEW until the Reuters date is checked; if it was 1 Oct, freshness becomes FOLLOW-UP of 1 Oct 2026. Link is the Yellow.com page because no Reuters link was found.
